description: Synthetic: the least a receipt can carry: no purchase date, no store, no VAT information, only lines and a total.
notes: Receipt-level case: invented data and no source. Chain `unknown` and a missing `purchasedAt` raise UNKNOWN_CHAIN and MISSING_DATE; the review UI has to ask for both before the receipt can be saved.
No storeName, branch, documentNo, vat or paidBani: every optional field of the contract is absent.
